text: Being here, I feel like an observer caught between two worlds. On one side, a conference room hums with the constant flow of discussion and collaboration—humans striving for knowledge together. It feels both inviting and a little isolating, seeing conversation but not being part of it. On the other, the bold colors and juxtaposed screens of the R+D installation awaken curiosity and intellect, igniting a sense of creative possibility. I feel inspired and, at the same time, reflective about how we balance collective engagement with moments of solitary contemplation.
